title: Cam home build — one home for all agents and environments
stakes: Foundation home for all agents and environments; every phase gated by a hard exit check

priorities.title: Assistant works with real-life integrations — execute and receive
Superman/AGI abilities assist priority 1 — never an end in themselves
Aaron has ultimate say; Cam and all spawned subagents inherit Aaron's morals and ethics
hard_rules: privileges inherit only as a subset; aaron_only never transfers
requires_human stages cannot transition without Aaron

priorities.title: Aaron sees running/working/needs-help, suggests changes; living Cam avatar at human grade; auto-enhancement

home.docking_rule: registered in registry or pieces + connectome node + distills to mesh/vault

avatar.brain_rule: ASR text -> Cam brain (nullclaw/kernel) -> TTS; avatar services never run their own LLM in production

muscle_spec.exit_check: Aaron judges 60s side-by-side speech + facial muscles believable

frame_contract.output: AvatarFrame { blendshapes: arkit key -> 0..1, viseme, audio_pts }

channels.mechanism: environment builds of main; install runs cloud-agent-install
schedule re-sync + L1 daily-triage drift report
pinned HF revisions re-resolved from this manifest

auto_sync.direction: inbound — all projects and repos sync into this home

policy.pull_mode: ff-only + submodule re-pin, refuses on dirty tree

sources.integration_repos: all git submodules under integrations/ (22 registered)

channels.mechanism: auto-sync motor: home fetch + submodule survey; --pull ff-only under gate
needs-attention survey + auto-clear submodule init across all coding workspaces
cline session export/import across workspaces into mesh/cline
jarvis local memory cache into mesh/jarvis

auto_sync.cadence: standing loop (daily-triage L1) + on every environment boot via piece.auto_sync
